title: Clients can list all customer records through the admin API
summary: GET /api/admin/customers returns 200 to client accounts from two different companies; the spec and business rules say only admins may see customers.
steps: Sign in over the API as acme-1
GET /api/admin/customers (see evidence for the curl command)
actual: HTTP 200 with the customer list for acme-1 and bright-1 (and zain-1, acme-2 in the role matrix)
suspected_cause: Missing admin role check on the customers route (the sales report route has one)

regression_test.description: As a client, GET /api/admin/customers and expect 403

title: A client can read another company's order by id
summary: GET /api/orders/{id} returns 200 for an order that belongs to a different company.
steps: Sign in over the API as acme-1 and POST /api/orders (QA-rule-small), note the order id
Sign in as bright-1 (Bright Foods) and GET /api/orders/{that id}
suspected_cause: Order detail handler does not compare the order's client_id with the caller's company

regression_test.description: Client A creates an order; client B GETs it and expects 403/404

title: Signing out does not revoke the session token
summary: After POST /api/auth/logout the same token still works on GET /api/me.
steps: Sign in over the API as zain-1
suspected_cause: Logout does not add the token to a revoked list, or the check ignores it

title: Tax is calculated on the undiscounted subtotal for orders of 1,000.00 or more
summary: The 5% discount is applied, but tax is 10% of the full subtotal instead of the discounted subtotal, so customers are overcharged. The confirmation page shows the same wrong total.
steps: Sign in over the API as acme-1
POST /api/orders with product p-102 (12.50) quantity 80, subtotal 1,000.00
Same in Client Portal: New order, Ballpoint Pens x80, Place order; confirmation says Total $1,050.00
actual: Total 1,050.00 (x100: 1,312.50; p-101 x1000: 6,825.00). Discount itself is correct; orders just below 1,000.00 (x79) are correct.
suspected_cause: Tax computed from subtotal rather than subtotal minus discount

regression_test.description: Order of exactly 1,000.00 expects tax 95.00 and total 1,045.00

title: Order creation accepts invalid quantities and an empty item list
summary: POST /api/orders returns 201 for quantity 0, 1001, 1.5 and for an empty items array, though quantity must be a whole number 1-1000 and an order needs at least one item.
steps: Sign in over the API as acme-1
POST /api/orders with items [] , then quantity 0, 1001, 1.5 (see evidence)
suspected_cause: No server-side validation of items or quantity

regression_test.description: POST orders with empty items and out-of-range quantities, expect 400

title: Malformed JSON responses expose stack traces and server file paths
summary: Sending broken JSON to POST /auth/login or POST /orders returns 400 with a trace field containing a stack trace and local file paths.
expected: A short error message without internal detail
actual: Body includes stack trace and absolute server file paths
suspected_cause: Error handler serialises err.stack into the response

regression_test.description: Malformed JSON returns 400 with no trace field

title: GET /orders returns HTTP 500 for page_size=0 and for q=( or q=\
summary: Edge query values crash the orders list; also page_size=-1 is accepted with 200 although the spec minimum is 1.
steps: Sign in over the API as acme-1 or admin
Observe HTTP 500 each time; page_size=-1 gives 200
expected: HTTP 400 for invalid page_size; search text treated literally
suspected_cause: q is used as a raw regular expression; page_size is not range-checked (division by zero)

regression_test.description: GET orders with page_size=0 and q=( expects 400/200, never 500

title: Order creation is not protected against double submission
summary: Two identical simultaneous POST /orders were all accepted with 201. I did not confirm that duplicate orders are stored with different ids, and I do not know whether the product intends idempotency.
steps: Send the same POST /api/orders twice in parallel
expected: One order, or a clear duplicate warning
suspected_cause: No idempotency key or duplicate check

regression_test.description: Two parallel identical orders create at most one

title: Sales report endpoint takes about 4 seconds
summary: GET /api/admin/reports/sales consistently takes 4.0 s (limit 3 s); the Reports page waits equally long.
suspected_cause: Slow aggregation or an artificial delay

title: Product dropdown on New order has no accessible name
summary: The product select has no label, so screen readers announce it only by its first option. The page audit flagged it and it was seen again after a page reload.
steps: Sign in to the Client Portal as acme-1
Run the page audit or read the accessibility snapshot: the product select has no name
suspected_cause: Select rendered without label or aria-label

regression_test.description: Product select has an accessible name
